Sahilia

Overview

Sahilia is a thief living in the Last Shelter. Her stolen Joon antiquities give Zak a lead to the collector Baluddin, while her knowledge of hiding places and wealthy houses opens other opportunities. She can accompany him, but asks to return to Suslanger rather than stay on Gipath, where she would have few profitable targets. [1, 2, 3]

Sahilia’s cache and the Joon collector

Sahilia supplies the next lead through her own theft. Antiquities she stole from Baluddin remain hidden near the city, and Zak recovers them to arrange a meeting. Khatul and Brother Blacksmith help choose the secluded trading place, keeping strangers away from the Shelter. Baluddin admits recognising At-Zako as a living Joon and wanting to keep him in his own house. Imperial scholars took the young man away. Later, Taivo summoned the collector to identify those scholars’ mutilated bodies. The missing youth’s trail now leads to the necromancers rather than a living prisoner whom Zak can simply rescue. [1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
